title: Hearthstone of the Death Squad
paragraphs: A crime series built around Inspector Hearthstone, a recurring detective character who emerged from Mystery Theatre and investigates murder cases with a Scotland Yard-style procedural flavor.

CBS sustaining detective series centered on Inspector Hearthstone, successor/extension of the Hummerts Mystery Theatre lineage. Frozen GRH set preserves programs 1, 16 and 20 from the run; broader episode count/history is complicated by Mystery Theatre repeats.
GRH documents the program through CBS Hearthstone run (August 30, 1951 to 1952) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Alfred Shirley (performer on 3 recordings), Anne Hummert (producer on 3 recordings), Henry Howard (director on 3 recordings), Frank Hummert (writer (performer on 2 recordings), Harry Cramer (announcer on 2 recordings), producer) (performer on 2 recordings), and Art Hannes (announcer on 1 recording).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include police investigation and homicide squad, murder-case procedural, Hummert mystery-radio production lineage, missing heiress and identity concealment, marriage annulment and domestic motive, and narcotics and organized crime.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Hearthstone of the Death Squad CBS run, Hummert Mystery Theatre lineage, and Fragmentary surviving Hearthstone corpus.
